0022600152.text: Minnesota (4-2) enters on a one-game winning streak, is 4-2 over its last ten, 2-1 on the road, and third in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, while San Antonio (3-2) has won three straight, is 1-2 at home and 2-0 on the road, and sits fourth in the Southwest, 2 games back. The Timberwolves are without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery, out; 33.3 points per game this season), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery, out), and Rudy Gobert (back spasms, day-to-day with a game-time decision; 7.0 points per game this season), and the Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). This is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season, following a 2-1 Timberwolves regular-season series win in 2025-26 and a 2-4 Timberwolves loss in the 2025-26 playoffs, with the most recent game a 139-109 Timberwolves loss in Minneapolis in the playoffs on May 15, 2026.
